description: Large apartment located in Villeneuve la Garenne, in the center, close to Paris (10-minute walk from the RER D), the Stade de France and the Olympic Pool (20-minute tram ride/30-minute walk).Perfect accommodation for the 2024 Olympics!Surrounded by shops and cafés, a 10-minute walk from a shopping center with many stores.The spaceThe apartment consists of 7 rooms: - a large living room bathed in natural light, with a 2-seater sofa bed- a dining room- a fully equipped kitchen- 3 bedrooms with double bed- a bathroom with bathtub and toilet- a small bathroom with shower- Separate toilet You'll find all mod cons, including a large TV (with Netflix and OCS included), fast Wi-Fi, dishwasher, washing machine, dryer, etc.Other things to noteThe apartment is non-smoking. Family atmosphere and respect for the neighborhood to be maintained.3 nights minimum.English translation if requested.We can't wait to welcome you!
